judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the access decision first, unconditionally appends a complete log record (role, permission, allowed, plus a bonus timestamp), and only then returns — making it structurally impossible for any code path to bypass the audit write. The logic is flat (no nesting, no early returns), explicit (typed signatures, named boolean), and locally auditable in a single glance. The docstring is thorough without being bloated, and the use of UTC-aware ISO-8601 timestamps is a sensible, unobtrusive addition that strengthens the audit trail without violating any stated constraint.
